scope: Self-audited conditional PDE analysis with independent review outstanding

claims.statement: Time-dependent threshold reference profile meets the O(epsilon^2) squared trace budget from its amplitude bound
Full cubic L1 preimages have low-output impulse observation kernels bounded uniformly in space by C(1+t)^-1/2
Actual full cubic trace, whole local-continuum and compact trace squared integrals are O(epsilon^2)
Translated fixed profiles can have logarithmically growing weighted spectral differences with bounded L1 and H1 norms
Actual correctors, mixed coercivity and o(epsilon^2) integrated action-work error across three radiative channels
